accounting_contract.availability_clock: Earliest exact official NSE/BSE dissemination timestamp for the same ISIN and financial period
accounting_contract.restatement_limitation: The later hash-pinned Screener export may contain vendor restatements; source_observed_at and workbook hashes remain visible

aggregation.across_dates: Report every date separately; aggregate only equal-weight valid sector-date observations

comparison.baseline: Unchanged Baseline V1 reranked within each sector on exactly the final V2-and-outcome-eligible cohort
comparison.research_v2: Unchanged Research V2 scoring on the same cohort

future_returns.adjusted_price_semantics: Yahoo Adj Close endpoint / Yahoo Adj Close on ranking date - 1
future_returns.endpoint: Last trading observation on or before the calendar target
future_returns.missing_outcome: Exclude the security from both model sides and report the exact reason
future_returns.outcome_isolation: Ranking, eligibility, cohort, formulas and configuration are frozen before return values are read

allowed: Per-date and per-sector descriptive ranking agreement
Paired model differences on valid sector-date observations
Explicit coverage, exclusions and concentration limitations
forbidden: Statistical significance inferred from four dates

metrics.primary: Sector-date Spearman Rank IC at 12 months
secondary: Top-ranked-stock excess return versus its matched sector
metrics.ties: Average ranks for Spearman; tau-b tie correction; model ties receive 0.5 pairwise credit; exact outcome ties are excluded
metrics.top_n: Within each sector use min(5, cohort size), preserve reported ties, and use ticker only for deterministic exact-N cutoff

portfolio_boundary.equal_weight: Only within transparent top/bottom descriptive baskets
portfolio_boundary.transaction_cost_reason: No executable portfolio or supported cost model is part of this experiment
portfolio_boundary.turnover: Optional descriptive identity overlap between adjacent annual selections; not a performance adjustment

universe.membership: Official NIFTY 50 membership from the corresponding NSE Indices July MCWB snapshot
universe.sector: Official date-applicable NSE Indices Sector tier
universe.survivorship_policy: Later broad/current issuer populations may not enter a historical ranking cohort
